options.content: NAS filesystem allocation is **physical**, shared by LUNs, snapshots and other data. PVC capacity and usage are **logical**, not NAS free space. Client latency is mean Linux I/O completion time, not p95 or DSM service time. Idle recovery-staging claims have no mounted device; that does not mean their LUN has failed. Namespace/PVC filters apply to Kubernetes and selected-LUN panels, not whole-NAS health or logs.

panels.title: Authenticated NAS scrape
panels.description: Scrape success is not a direct guarantee of working iSCSI. Missing data remains missing.

panels.title: Physical NAS filesystem free
panels.description: HOST-RESOURCES values converted to physical filesystem bytes; /volume3 verified against DSM df. Shared by LUNs, snapshots and other files, not virtual LUN capacity.

panels.title: Physical NAS filesystem available bytes
panels.description: Physical shared filesystem free space. Not summed PVC free space or per-LUN physical allocation.

panels.title: RAID state
panels.description: Vendor status codes are states, not an ordered health score. Expected repair or scrub transitions are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Drive health
panels.description: Vendor status codes are states, not an ordered health score. Expected repair or scrub transitions are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Drive operational state
panels.description: Vendor status codes are states, not an ordered health score. Expected repair or scrub transitions are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Drive busy time
panels.description: DSM disk-load gauge; RAID maintenance can legitimately saturate disks.

panels.title: NAS drive read throughput
panels.description: 64-bit byte counters include RAID and non-iSCSI activity. Their sum is not application throughput.

panels.title: NAS drive write throughput
panels.description: 64-bit byte counters include RAID and non-iSCSI activity. Their sum is not application throughput.

panels.title: NAS space-device IOPS
panels.description: All DSM space-device activity, not just selected Kubernetes claims.

panels.title: Selected LUNs: DSM instantaneous IOPS
panels.description: Instantaneous DSM gauges joined to current PVCs by decoded LUN name. Not a five-minute client average. Namespace/PVC filters apply.

panels.title: NAS interface traffic
panels.description: Per-interface counters; physical, virtual and bonded interfaces may observe the same traffic. Do not sum into a NAS total.

panels.title: NAS interface errors
panels.description: Errors per second, not accumulated history. Unused down interfaces are not storage failures.

options.content: Namespace and PVC selectors apply below. Client metrics use Linux block counters joined to mounted PVCs. DSM does not specify units for native LUN latency, so these values are intentionally not labelled as milliseconds. Existing PVC-capacity and VolSync alerts are reused. Backup health is current source synchronization state, not an invented last-success timestamp.

panels.title: Current Synology claims
panels.description: Includes recovery staging, cache and temporary claims.

panels.title: Mounted iSCSI block devices
panels.description: Idle recovery staging is intentionally absent from node block metrics.

panels.title: Backup sources out of sync
panels.description: Current MinIO/R2 source objects joined to existing Synology PVCs. Missing data is not coerced to healthy zero.

panels.title: Client read IOPS
panels.description: Five-minute rates from mounted Linux iSCSI block devices, joined to current PVC names.

panels.title: Client write IOPS
panels.description: Five-minute rates from mounted Linux iSCSI block devices, joined to current PVC names.

panels.title: Client read throughput
panels.description: Five-minute rates from mounted Linux iSCSI block devices, joined to current PVC names.

panels.title: Client write throughput
panels.description: Five-minute rates from mounted Linux iSCSI block devices, joined to current PVC names.

panels.title: Client read mean completion latency
panels.description: Five-minute mean Linux completion time, not p95 or isolated NAS service time. Idle devices have no mean; gaps are intentional. Alert: over 100 ms at more than 1 IOPS for 15 minutes.

panels.title: Client write mean completion latency
panels.description: Five-minute mean Linux completion time, not p95 or isolated NAS service time. Idle devices have no mean; gaps are intentional. Alert: over 100 ms at more than 1 IOPS for 15 minutes.

panels.title: Mounted PVC filesystem used
panels.description: Logical filesystem utilization inside mounted claims, not physical NAS allocation.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - min by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",persistentvolumeclaim=~"${claim:regex}"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",persistentvolumeclaim=~"${claim:regex}"})) and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{storageclass=~"synology-iscsi.*",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",persistentvolumeclaim=~"${claim:regex}"})

panels.title: Mounted PVC filesystem free
panels.description: Logical free space inside mounted PVCs. Unmounted recovery staging has no kubelet filesystem sample.

targets.expr: min by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",persistentvolumeclaim=~"${claim:regex}"}) and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_info{storageclass=~"synology-iscsi.*",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",persistentvolumeclaim=~"${claim:regex}"})

panels.title: Current backup source health
panels.description: 0 = synchronized; 1 = out of sync. MinIO and R2 remain separate. Joins exclude deleted historical objects.

panels.title: Active storage alerts
panels.description: Cluster-wide storage alerts, not filtered by namespace/PVC. An empty table is normal when no alerts fire.

panels.title: Storage event logs and independent notifications

options.content: Logs are NAS/cluster-wide and do not follow claim selectors. DSM forwards system and disk events, excluding file-access audit traffic. CSI pod logs retain node_name. Some Talos kernel events have node=unknown because SNAT hides their origin; no identity is guessed. DSM email notifications are configured independently of Kubernetes, with storage warning/error rules enabled. Email delivery has not been tested by this dashboard.

panels.title: DSM storage and system events
panels.description: Native DSM system/disk events over TCP from 10.0.16.16. Empty means no events in the selected range, not proof of a working forwarder.

panels.title: Synology CSI warnings and errors
panels.description: CSI controller and node-plugin context; inspect node_name and pod_name labels. An empty error view is normal on a healthy system.

panels.title: Talos kernel storage context
panels.description: Normal attach/detach and cache events are included. SNAT-origin events may retain node=unknown.
